en.python-install: Use ordinary CPython 3.11+ with a matching platform wheel; the recorded checks cover 3.11–3.14. Create the environment with python -m venv .venv, activate it (. .venv/bin/activate, or .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 on Windows), then run python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1. Save the documented complete program as main.py and run python main.py. It creates persistent spanish.apkg containing one Basic hola → hello card in Spanish, with namespace spanish and note key es:hola. Keep both identity values stable. Anki is needed to inspect the import, not to export. Platform availability is not proof of every host configuration; consult the compatibility table for native targets.
en.node-api: Install with npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1 on Node.js 22.13+ with the matching native package. Create new Project(namespace), add a Note.basic or custom immutable model note under an explicit stable key, and await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path)). Successful BuildOutput exposes artifact/report/snapshot; BuildReport contains observations, not success or file ownership. Node properties such as highestRisk differ from snapshot highest_risk, so check comparison for null before use. Build/compare capture an owned project snapshot and run asynchronously. Keep a temporary artifact owner alive until readers finish; the last owner deletes temporary output, while persistent output survives close. A prepared publish attempt consumes the owner even on policy/I/O failure; reprepare to retry.
en.json-update: Put v1.json, v2.json, cell.png and tone.wav in recipe/ and use one complete public 0.3.1 Rust, Python or TypeScript program from the guide. The caller parses JSON; the library packages three notes, three cards and two exact media assets. The audio is a generated tone. Keep namespace biology-json and the three business IDs stable. Retain the original distributed v1.apkg and use a separate v2 destination; an Anki re-export is not an update baseline. Inspect comparison.json and review.json: the example reports only RISK.NOTE_CHANGED and permits publication of this one-answer edit. It checks the prepared candidate again before publishing and refuses an already occupied release directory. Import both versions and inspect the answer change; omission does not delete learner notes, and import settings/local edits still affect outcomes.
en.compatibility-constraints: The documented public version is 0.3.1, with a dated environment record: Rust 1.92+, Node 22.13+ and ordinary CPython 3.11–3.14 checks. Native packages cover macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64 GNU/glibc and Windows x64. Browser/Electron/Bun/Alpine-musl and ARM64 Linux/Windows lie outside the recorded Node scope; other Python implementations/free-threaded/subinterpreter use needs separate validation. Ordinary export needs no Anki. Package inspection does not establish every client's rendering, codecs or import/review behavior. Updates require the original distribution APKG; stable IDs do not override local edits or synchronize deletions. Inspection budgets apply independently to baseline/candidate and zero is not unlimited. Publication is atomic per APKG file, not an automatic durability guarantee; inspect publication facts after a late error. JSON reports do not own temporary files.

zh-CN.compatibility-constraints: 文档记录公开版本 0.3.1：Rust 1.92+、Node 22.13+、普通 CPython 3.11–3.14 的验证范围有明确日期。原生包覆盖 macOS arm64/x64、Linux x64 GNU/glibc、Windows x64；浏览器、Electron、Bun、Alpine/musl、ARM64 Linux/Windows 不在现有 Node 验证范围，其他 Python 实现、自由线程和子解释器需另行验证。正常导出不需 Anki，但导入、样式、编解码器和复习状态要在目标客户端检查。更新需要原始分发 APKG，稳定 ID 不保证覆盖本地编辑，也不提供删除同步。检查预算分别约束基线和候选，零不表示无限制。发布的原子性只针对单个 APKG，晚期持久性错误可能发生在替换成功后；应读实际发布事实。报告和 JSON 不持有临时文件。

ja.node-api: Node.js 22.13 以降で npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1 を使い、対応するネイティブ依存パッケージもインストールします。new Project(namespace) に安定キーで Note を追加し、await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path)) を呼びます。BuildOutput は artifact/report/snapshot を持ちますが、BuildReport は観測結果のみで、成否やファイル所有権は持ちません。comparison の null を確認し、オブジェクトの highestRisk と JSON の highest_risk を区別します。build/compare は呼び出し時の所有付きスナップショットを非同期処理します。一時ファイルを使う間は所有者を保持し、最後の close 後は消えます。永続ファイルは残ります。準備済み公開は失敗を含む全試行で所有者を消費するため、再試行には再準備が必要です。TypeScript は NodeNext の設定で npx tsc、.mts の出力は node dist/main.mjs で実行します。
ja.json-update: 実際に読んだ Python の完全プログラムを使う場合、recipe/ に v1.json・v2.json・cell.png・tone.wav を保存し、公開 ankiforge==0.3.1 をインストールします。main.py に例を保存して python main.py recipe output/python を実行します。呼び出し側が JSON を読み、各版にノート3件・カード3枚・元のメディア2個を同梱します。音声は短い合成音で、読み上げ機能ではありません。biology-json と3つの業務 ID を維持し、配布時のオリジナル v1.apkg を残して別パスに v2 を生成します。Anki の再エクスポートは基準に使えません。comparison.json と review.json の許可を確認し、同じ準備済み候補を公開します。この解答だけの変更は RISK.NOTE_CHANGED で、出力ディレクトリに既存の版があれば停止します。両版をインポートして解答と画像・音声を確認します。省略したノートの削除同期や全復習状態の保持は保証しません。tools::load_project は internal-tools 向けで、利用側の公開 API ではありません。
